import sys

def solve():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a1 = int(data[1])
    a2 = int(data[2])
    a3 = int(data[3])
    b1 = int(data[4])
    b2 = int(data[5])
    b3 = int(data[6])
    max_wins = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1)
    min_wins = min(a1, b1 + b3) + min(a2, b1 + b2) + min(a3, b2 + b3)
    min_wins = n - min_wins
    print(f"{min_wins} {max_wins}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()
